verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.reducto.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index linking to markdown versions of doc pages. Many pages are served as agent-friendly .md files (overview.md, cli.md, mcp-server.md, quickstart.md, and others), and a machine-readable openapi.json is also available. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit first-party guidance on pointing agents at these docs, and no independent or community corroboration of agents using them.
